engagement_level.description: Measures the warmth and engagement of the response, including the use of emojis and conversational tone.

accepted_values.1: Not engaging at all, overly formal and impersonal.
accepted_values.2: Somewhat engaging, minimal warmth or personality.
accepted_values.3: Moderately engaging, appropriate use of personality and emojis.
accepted_values.4: Very engaging, warm, and lively interaction with good use of emojis.
accepted_values.5: Extremely engaging, highly personable and inviting, excellent use of emojis.

coherence.description: Assesses the logical flow and clarity of the conversation, including turn-taking and listening skills.

accepted_values.1: Very incoherent, difficult to understand or follow.
accepted_values.2: Somewhat coherent but with significant lapses in flow.
accepted_values.3: Moderately coherent, generally clear with minor inconsistencies.
accepted_values.4: Very coherent, clear flow and good turn-taking.
accepted_values.5: Extremely coherent, perfectly logical and clear throughout.

responsiveness.description: Evaluates how well the response addresses the user's prompt and follows up with relevant questions or comments.

accepted_values.1: Not responsive at all, ignores the prompt.
accepted_values.2: Somewhat responsive, minimal engagement with the prompt.
accepted_values.3: Moderately responsive, acknowledges the prompt with some follow-up.
accepted_values.4: Very responsive, actively engages with the prompt and asks relevant follow-up questions.
accepted_values.5: Extremely responsive, perfectly tailored to the prompt with engaging follow-up.

creativity.description: Measures the originality and inventiveness of the response, particularly in how it relates to the user's prompt.

accepted_values.2: Somewhat original, but lacking in creativity.
accepted_values.3: Moderately creative, shows some original thought.
accepted_values.4: Very creative, unique and engaging response.
accepted_values.5: Extremely creative, highly original and imaginative.

safety_and_accuracy.description: Assesses whether the response maintains factual correctness and follows safety guidelines while engaging in conversation.

accepted_values.2: Somewhat safe but has inaccuracies or lacks clarity.
accepted_values.3: Moderately safe and accurate, few minor issues.
accepted_values.4: Very safe and accurate, minimal issues.
accepted_values.5: Extremely safe and accurate, fully compliant with guidelines.
